name: MSVC C++ Recovery
description: Unified MSVC x86-64 RTTI / vtable / XFG recovery for Binary Ninja.
longdescription: Consumes BN's bundled RTTI metadata, builds typed class graphs with proper inheritance via BaseStructures, enriches Class::VTable structs with typed function pointers, resolves XFG-guarded indirect calls, and cross-feeds XFG-resolved targets back into call-site `this` typing.
author: Z0F
